 End of an era: Hanging rock falls at Polar Caves Park 
 A historic boulder in a New Hampshire park has fallen after more than a century. By WCAX News Team Published : Oct. 20, 2026 at 6:55 AM EDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google RUMNEY, N.H. (WCAX) - A historic boulder in a New Hampshire park has fallen after more than a century.
 Officials with Polar Caves Park in Rumney said the mysterious hanging rock fell Sunday on the last day of the season.
 Polar Caves Park in Rumney, N.H. (WCAX) In a statement about the tourist attraction, park officials said, “for more than a century Polar Caves have welcomed families to experience the wonder of New Hampshire’s natural landscape. We are committed to ensuring that Polar Caves continues to be a fun, memorable and safe family attraction for generations to come.” 
 The park will evaluate the site during the offseason to determine its next steps.
